title: Según and reported statements: who gives each figure

sections.content: You know *según* + a source and reported statements from B1 Unit 13: *según la comisión…*, *la comisión dice que…*. When a number is disputed, you must say who gives it. Each source gets its own *según*, and what people said or claimed in the past is reported with *decían que*, *afirmó que* and similar verbs.

items.spanish: Según la CONADEP, 8.961 personas desaparecieron en Argentina.
items.english: According to the CONADEP, 8,961 people disappeared in Argentina.

items.spanish: Según las organizaciones de derechos humanos, fueron unas 30.000.
items.english: According to human-rights organisations, it was about 30,000.

items.spanish: Las autoridades decían que no sabían nada de las personas detenidas.
items.english: The authorities said they knew nothing about the people detained.

items.spanish: La Comisión Rettig afirmó que unas 2.300 personas murieron o desaparecieron.
items.english: The Rettig Commission stated that about 2,300 people were killed or disappeared.

sections.content: Never put *que* or *a* after *según*: *según la CONADEP*, not *según que la CONADEP*. Two different figures are not a mistake: put each one next to its source and the reader can see why they differ.
